# Isaiah Chapter 64 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 12 verses]*

*Rend the heavens; mountains quake; no eye has seen; we are the clay; righteous deeds like filthy rags*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 64 (Prayer for Mercy) addresses rend the heavens; mountains quake; no eye has seen; we are the clay; righteous deeds like filthy rags. The key verse — "We are the clay, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
